configOf(address).details: Returns the token-specific entry when its operator is non-zero, else the default entry.

params.token: The ERC20 token to look up.

returns.operator: The operator address that should receive the rake.
returns.rakeBps: The rake (in basis points) to apply at settlement.

returns.operator: The default operator that receives the rake when no override is set.
returns.rakeBps: The default rake (in basis points) applied when no override is set.

setDefault(address,uint256).details: Owner-only. Operator must be non-zero and rakeBps must be strictly below 10_000.

params.operator: The operator that should receive the rake when no override is set.
params.rakeBps: The default rake (in basis points) applied when no override is set.

setTokenConfig(address,address,uint256).details: Owner-only. Setting `operator` to address(0) clears the override and reverts to the default.

params.operator: The operator that should receive the rake (zero clears the override).
params.rakeBps: The rake (in basis points) to apply when the override is active.
params.token: The ERC20 token whose configuration is being set.

defaultConfig().notice: Returns the global default `(operator, rakeBps)` configuration.

setDefault(address,uint256).notice: Sets the global default rake configuration.

setTokenConfig(address,address,uint256).notice: Sets the per-token rake configuration for `token`.
